basics.name: Thomas Ingram
basics.label: Full-Stack Web Developer; Problem Solver; Collaborator; Mentor
basics.summary: Self-taught full-stack web developer with a strong desire for new challenges. Build, contribute to and maintain open source projects. Maintain several sites, some built from scratch and some CMS-based. Attend trade meetings and conferences regularly. Mentor junior developers. Open source work hosted on GitHub. Many people across several companies have told me how much they appreciate working with me and how much they have learned from me.

work.name: CISYS LifeSciences
work.summary: Configure, build and maintain websites and web applications for clients. Advocate for test-driven development and other best practices.

work.name: RoleModel Software
work.summary: Worked with clients to build various web applications. Projects included a standalone kiosk for distributing media in second-world countries, an accident report downloader, weather forecasting application and several large medical related applications. Mentored younger developers one-on-one.

work.name: Gather Digital
work.summary: Added a contact sharing feature for native Android app. Worked on custom-built CMS/API. Built in-house tooling for submitting apps to Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store. Implemented and streamlined many integration projects to pull client data from various third-party REST and SOAP APIs.

work.name: NetApp
work.summary: Help develop a new tool which allows sales people to easily configure large enterprise server rooms for clients. Collaborated with an international team of developers. Built many React components and helper functions in a shared presentation library. Mentored younger developers.
highlights: Mentored younger developers on my team.

work.name: Rivers Agency
work.summary: Led developer team git training. Architected and helped build a distributed clinical management system for a local university. Managed and helped build REST and GraphQL APIs, data-driven static sites and component library. Implemented many smaller features and bug fixes for a variety of projects.
highlights: Built a distributed clinical management system for a local university, including a custom OAuth2 provider for SSO.
Architected and implemented a custom frontend powered by GraphQL and React.
Helped maintain, test and improve multiple Magento powered sites.

work.name: Lana
work.summary: Debit bank account for the unbanked/underbanked with pawn loan management features. Developed new frontend architecture. Worked with team to deliver solutions allowing customers more flexibility for managing finances.
highlights: Designed and implemented new modular frontend architecture.
Built first payment integration with a third-party payment processor for pawn loan extensions.

work.name: EZCORP
work.summary: Extensive work with React, Redux and TypeScript. Built a new frontend architecture for the company's pawn loan management system. Implemented new features and improved existing ones to enhance user experience. Collaborated with backend developers to integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints. Worked with Design to implement two new design systems.
highlights: Built current and new design system from scratch using React, TypeScript and Storybook.
Architected and implemented bespoke promotion system for different types of promotions including giveaways and fun interactive elements.

education.details: Spent significant time learning programming languages, frameworks and tools through online courses, tutorials and personal projects. Built a portfolio of web applications and contributed to open-source projects.
Earned a certificate in MySQL Database Design, gaining knowledge in database architecture, normalization and query optimization.

testimonials.name: Alfredo Chico
